days.title: Build a rate-limited API middleware
days.brief: Recruiters skim commit histories before they read resumes. Today's build shows you can reason about abuse and load, not just happy paths.
spec: Write an Express (or Fastify) middleware that limits a client to 20 requests per minute per IP.
Return a 429 with a clear JSON error body and a Retry-After header when the limit is hit.
Store counters in memory using a sliding window, not a fixed reset clock.
Add one test that proves the 21st request in a minute is rejected.
